thread:
jules_support: FYI customer 'NimbusApps' flagged a huge invoice discrepancy. dashboard shows 95,420 tokens for billing window; invoice (INV-2024-1192) shows 312,985. attaching screenshot link: https://invoices.internal/nimbus/INV-2024-1192
lee_billing: this is big. any recent model or bulk import on their account?
tom_sre: checking ingest and event pipeline. ops-bot: eventstream reported consumer-lag on metering-stream between 2024-10-28T23:50Z and 2024-10-29T00:30Z. backlog-triggered replay at 2024-10-29T00:35Z.
erin_ops: snapshot of eventstore at 00:33Z shows ~64,200 pending metering messages across shards 3/8. looks like replay processed ~63k messages.
ryan_eng: could this be duplicates hitting ledger? did dedupe service fail-over?
ops-bot: dedupe-service healthcheck failed 2024-10-29T00:12Z: grpc deadline exceeded; recover at 2024-10-29T00:40Z.
tom_sre: sounds like some events were not deduped during replay. need a quick audit. suggest running an event_id distinct count vs ledger entries for the window.
ryan_eng: quick SQL I ran:
```
SELECT count(distinct event_id) as unique_events, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM ledger_events
WHERE customer='nimbus' AND created_at >= '2024-10-28' AND created_at < '2024-10-30';
```
ryan_eng: results: unique_events=67,120 tokens=312,985
jules_support: dashboard shows tokens=95,420. where do the extra ~217k tokens come from?
lee_billing: dashboard is based on near-real-time metrics pipeline (stream aggregates). invoices are computed from ledger which is authoritative and uses replayed events when backfill occurs.
tom_sre: run a pre/post replay snapshot: before replay unique_events=3,100 tokens=95,420; after replay unique_events=70,220 tokens=312,985. looks like ~67,120 events were reintroduced; dedupe failed to filter previously processed messages.
ryan_eng: dedupe logs snippet:
```
2024-10-29T00:11:54Z ERROR dedupe: shard=3 read timeout err=connection reset
2024-10-29T00:13:01Z WARN dedupe: fallback disabled for window start=2024-10-28T23:00Z
```
erin_ops: replay job id replay-20241029-3 processed batches with checksums: batch_001 md5=ab12..., batch_002 md5=cd34..., total_replayed=63,120
jules_support: customer wants timeline + repro steps. can we produce a short blurb and an ETA for credits?
lee_billing: ETA for audit and remediation plan: 3 hours. plan: run dedupe-cleaner to identify duplicates, generate correction entries to adjust ledger (reverse duplicate token credits), regenerate invoice and issue credit note if needed.
ryan_eng: I'll prepare dedupe-cleaner run with --confirm to remove duplicates. dry-run on staging produced delta tokens -217,565 and removed 63,120 duplicate events.
tom_sre: schedule maintenance window 02:30-02:45Z to run in prod with snapshot and auto-rollback on mismatch.
ops-bot: dedupe-cleaner dry-run summary uploaded to /artifacts/incidents/2024-10-29-nimbus-dedupe/dryrun_summary.log
jules_support: shared initial note with customer: "We're investigating a metering replay that caused duplicate events to be applied to the ledger. We're running an audit and remediation; expect a corrected invoice and credit within 24 hours." they acknowledged :thumbsup: 
ryan_eng: applying dedupe-cleaner now (run id dc-20241029-nimbus-1): command:
```
dedupe-cleaner --customer nimbus --from '2024-10-28T00:00:00Z' --to '2024-10-30T00:00:00Z' --apply
```
ops-bot: dedupe-cleaner completed: duplicates_removed=63,120 tokens_adjusted=-217565 duration=10m42s
lee_billing: post-clean ledger tokens = 95,420 (matches near-real-time dashboard within rounding). triggering invoice regeneration INV-2024-1192/corrected
qa_bot: regen test passed; checksum of corrected invoice matches expected values.
jules_support: sending corrected invoice link to customer and opening billing ticket #BILL-4610 for credit approval. customer asked for RCA and steps to avoid recurrence.
tom_sre: immediate mitigations: 1) make dedupe index resilient to transient errors (retry/backoff), 2) add pre-replay dedupe verification hook, 3) add alert when replay_processed_tokens > live_metric_tokens * 1.3
lee_billing: I'll draft the credit memo and internal approval chain.
jules_support: thanks everyone. moving thread to postmortem and incident binder. will follow up with SLA impact note.
